theorem tsum_norm_le_variation {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) (hfs : HasCompactSupport f)
    {V : ℝ} (hV0 : 0 ≤ V) (hV : eVariationOn f Set.univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal V) :
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖f n‖) ∧ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖f n‖ ≤ (∫ t, ‖f t‖) + V / 2 :=

note: Lean states the two bounds with total variation in place of |f′|₁ (equal for continuous piecewise-C¹ f) and requires continuity for the first, which avoids the book's isolated-value counterexample. Erratum: (2.2) is stated for compactly supported piecewise continuous f with |f′|₁ counting jumps, and it fails when an integer value f(n) lies off [f(n−), f(n+)]: for f = 1_{0} the left side is 1 and the right side 0, and for f = 1_{[−1,1]} − 0.01·1_{0} at α = 1/2 it is 1.01 > 1 (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_2_2.py`).
